resources.string: Handles Enter and optional F8 dictation only when official ChatGPT controls are unambiguously identified. Prompt contents are never read or logged.
Only affects the official ChatGPT message composer. No prompt text is read, stored, or logged.

Enter / Numpad Enter: send
Shift+Enter: newline
F8: start or stop dictation
Enter while dictating: send

F8 is off by default and remains experimental until normal Chat and Remote pass DeX testing.
